content:
Randy Rainbow once again skewers President Trump with a raunchy R-rated parody of "The Surrey with the Fringe On Top" from Rodgers & Hammerstein's Oklahoma! (Video plays below.)

The six-time Emmy-nominated singer croons: "He's a creep, he's a dope, he's a heel, he's a sycophant with an orange crook and a weave on his head. But don't mind the face of death, the empty head, the mumbo jumbo, he buys cheap tickets and carpets, and his polls go down!"

Introducing his new video on social media Thursday, Rainbow once again played on the title of an Oklahoma! song, writing: "Oh what a beautiful moron."
